Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Petaniqua (basic) is in a combat with some other vampire in which
Weather Control has been played. That combat goes to the second round,
by which time Pettie's opponent has no blood.

1) In what order do WC and Pettie's special resolve?

2) If Pettie's special resolves first, does she still have to take the
damage from WC?

Never really having understood the WC clarifications, I'm not even
going to attempt to guess the answers to these questions.

Relevant card texts:
Petaniqua
During any round of combat after the first, a minion opposing
Petaniqua takes 2 points of damage before range is determined.

Weather Control
Both combatants and each of their retainers take 1 unpreventable
damage before range is determined each round.

John Eno

Messages.Author: Meej
Messages.Body:
On Oct 12, 12:06 pm, Kushiel <invisibleking...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Petaniqua (basic) is in a combat with some other vampire in which
> Weather Control has been played. That combat goes to the second round,
> by which time Pettie's opponent has no blood.
>
> 1) In what order do WC and Pettie's special resolve?

Wouldn't it depend on which order the active Methuselah wants to order
them in? (In other words, on who's acting and who's blocking/rushed?)

> 2) If Pettie's special resolves first, does she still have to take the
> damage from WC?

I'd imagine no - the combat's ended - but I can't say 100% for sure.

- D.J.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


I'm not sure it still applies, but I found that:

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/b0195c1f6a633649

which would mean that, however the combat ends in the before range
step, any stuff that should still be done in there must be done.

There's probably a weird timing (and a lot of possible questions
involving Flesh of Marble).

I'd say, when a minion goes to torpor in the before range step (or is
burned or sent to uncontrolled or removed from the game)
1- Resolve any underlying "during the before range step" effects and
end the "before range" step. Prevention and non-prevention cards that
are usually played in there could probably be played. See threads
about Outside the Hourglass and WC for more fun !
2- Skip to end of round.
3- End of combat.
